title: Autoregressive View Model
author: Jensen, Zhou, Samuel Rota Bulo, Denis Rozumny et al.
description: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. summary: (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path.
takeaways: We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation.
We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency.
We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift.
